desc: Build per-index list of smaller endpoints from each pair (swap if needed).
For each index i, sort its list descending and compute max1[i] and max2[i] (distinct second max, 0 if absent).
Compute base = sum(i - max1[i]) for i in 1..n.
For each original pair (a, b), determine larger endpoint `big` and smaller `small`, then compute gain: if max1[big] == small then max1[big] - max2[big] else 0.
Track max_gain across all pairs and return base + max_gain.
